research_question: When every A cue has exactly two changed-sign anchors, does one-step replay merely expose the tie rule while magnitude-two replacement restores both balanced target classes?

fixture.A_and_B_maps: Independently rank cues by SHA-256 of seed|cue|A-map or seed|cue|B-map; first four are target 0 and last four target 1.
fixture.initial_wrong_B_cues: Rank B cues by SHA-256 of namespace|initial_wrong|seed|cue and invert the first four true labels. Other B labels remain correct.
fixture.anchor_B_cues: For each A cue, rank only the four initially wrong B cues by SHA-256 of namespace|anchor|seed|A_cue|B_cue and select the first two distinct cues. This is an oracle-conditioned diagnostic fixture, not an online selector.
fixture.anchor_actions: Forced A actions 0 and 1 in that order; forced B action is the low bit of SHA-256(namespace|B_action|seed|A_cue|anchor_index). Global success is computed from the true XOR target.
fixture.early_updates: One B-interpreted old-sign packet update on each of the two source-matched A branches per cue; 16 anchors total.
fixture.revision: After both early updates, all eight B cues receive their exact local labels. No further ordinary A updates occur.
fixture.test: Complete 8x8 A/B cue factorial, 64 predictions per seed; no test-time updates.

arms.prior_tie_zero: No replay; A predicts branch 0 on a tied score.
arms.simple_tie_zero: One revised signed step per changed source; predict branch 0 on a tie.
arms.simple_tie_one: The identical one-step updates and packets as simple_tie_zero; predict branch 1 on a tie.
arms.correction_tie_zero: Two revised signed steps per changed source with magnitude bucket two; predict branch 0 on a tie.
arms.correction_tie_one: The identical two-step updates and packets as correction_tie_zero; predict branch 1 on a tie.
arms.sign_shuffle_two_step: Invert every revised packet sign before the two local steps.
arms.route_shuffle_two_step: Send every revised packet to the opposite recorded A branch for the two local steps.
